shadows.name: workbench-lift
shadows.purpose: Maximum resting elevation for the live workbench.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action in a working region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; background: oklch(0.2 0.018 250); color: white; font: 650 13px/1.3 'Figtree Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.28 0.025 250); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.15 275); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.012 250); border-radius: 10px; padding: 13px 18px; background: white; color: oklch(0.2 0.018 250); font: 650 13px/1.3 'Figtree Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.972 0.006 250); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.15 275); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Runtime Field
components.description: A clear multiline field for runtime cards and tasks.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Runtime card<textarea class="ds-field" placeholder="Paste the public runtime card"></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: oklch(0.2 0.018 250); font: 650 13px/1.3 'Figtree Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 96px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.012 250); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; background: white; color: oklch(0.2 0.018 250); font: 450 15px/1.5 'Figtree Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.15 275); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Actor Chip
components.description: A stable identity marker for one system actor.
components.css: .ds-actor-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; background: oklch(0.95 0.015 190); color: oklch(0.32 0.07 190); font: 650 13px/1.3 'Figtree Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-actor-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.43 0.09 190); }

components.name: Code Panel
components.css: .ds-code { overflow: auto; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; background: oklch(0.2 0.018 250); color: white; font: 450 13px/1.6 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

narrative.overview: Agent Connect Canvas is a precise workbench in a bright studio: the useful machinery is visible, every handoff is marked, and nothing important is hidden behind decorative spectacle. The neutral foundation keeps the application calm while a functional palette identifies the web app, connector, agent, in-flight work, and outcome.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral-first product surfaces with color reserved for actors and state.
A real execution trace, not a decorative architecture illustration.
Familiar controls and code artifacts that make the integration credible.
Crisp structure, compact radii, and purposeful state motion.
Desktop clarity with a complete touch-first mobile path.

rules.name: The Actor Color Rule
rules.body: Coral means app, teal means connector, and periwinkle means agent everywhere. Never reuse them as generic decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Voice Rule
rules.body: Prose explains; monospace proves. Never use monospace to make ordinary marketing copy look technical.

rules.name: The Structural-First Rule
rules.body: Use spacing, dividers, and surface contrast before adding shadow. Never pair a decorative wide shadow with a decorative border.

dos: Do lead with the working interaction and let architecture unfold from real events.
Do keep actor colors stable across diagrams, status messages, and code annotations.
Do show runtime cards, scopes, tool schemas, and event payloads as real evidence behind progressive disclosure.
donts: Don't create a futuristic science-fiction AI interface.
Don't create a generic gradient-heavy AI startup landing page.
Don't turn the experience into a terminal-first hacker demo that excludes web developers.
Don't create a dense enterprise-security dashboard that makes the integration feel intimidating.
